name: Тира Ортек
notes: Тира Ортек is a young dwarf rune-cutter, apprenticed to the rune and construct master of Kragmir, and the loudest player at the Sixth Facet, the closed dice club in the Upper Vaults. The workshop is booked twenty-three days out and the deposits are already in the drawer, so she has more coin than judgement and bets accordingly. She cuts runes well and casts above her rank: her party trick is a Fireball nobody has cleared her to cast, and it works about half the time. She will talk about the workshop to anyone who asks, including whose workshop it is.

actions.name: Overambitious Spell
actions.text:
Frequency once per day

Effect Тира's teacher has told her she's not ready for this spell, but desperate times call for desperate measures. Тира attempts to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fireball] as a 3rd-rank arcane spell but must first attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11].

Critical Success The spell is cast flawlessly and heightened to 4th rank. Тира is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 2} from sheer shock.

Success Nothing goes wrong, and the spell is cast normally.

Failure The spell fizzles and creates only a harmless puff of smoke.

Critical Failure Academic ablaze! Тира takes @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage as the magic backfires

actions.name: Runework Specialist
actions.text: For encounters involving rune-cutting, constructs, or crafting, Тира is a 7th-level challenge.

actions.name: Steady Spellcasting
actions.text: If another creature's reaction disrupts Тира's spellcasting action, Тира attempts a @Check[flat|dc:15]. If she succeeds, her action isn't disrupted.
